metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented under `/workspace/output` and verified with release runs.

What changed:
- [`exec.rs`](/workspace/output/src/exec.rs)
  - Routed canned cycles through the corrected builder.
  - Fixed G81/G82/G83/G84/G85/G86/G87/G88/G89 sequencing, including proper R-vs-clear handling in incremental mode.
  - Added G38.2 as a dedicated probe path with:
    - linear-axis presence validation
    - rotary-axis no-move validation
    - probe-tool validation
    - trip-point handling
    - probe parameter writes merged into the final trace entry
    - non-trip error after the motion completes
  - Folded post-motion `M2`/`M30` state resets into the final motion trace entry instead of emitting a separate state-only entry.
  - Fixed G28/G30 label propagation so a zero-length first hop does not leak its label into the second hop.
  - Tightened G53 validation to require at least one axis word.
- [`parser.rs`](/workspace/output/src/parser.rs)
  - Fixed G-code parsing so decimal codes like `G38.2`, `G59.1`, `G61.1`, `G92.1`, etc. are accepted instead of being rejected as invalid.
- [`main.rs`](/workspace/output/src/main.rs) and [`json.rs`](/workspace/output/src/json.rs)
  - Kept the CLI and JSON output plumbing working with the simulator state/trace model.

Validation I ran:
- `cargo check --manifest-path /workspace/output/Cargo.toml`
- `cargo run --release --manifest-path /workspace/output/Cargo.toml -- --input ... --output ... --trace-output ...` on:
  - a simple `G1 X1 F60`
  - a `G81` canned-cycle example
  - a successful `G38.2` probe
  - a non-tripping `G38.2` probe
  - a `G28` case with a zero-length first hop

The release builds and the JSON/trace outputs were valid in those cases.
